prompt: A red fox trots through fresh snow in a sunlit pine forest, its breath steaming in the cold air. The camera tracks alongside it at ground level. Snow crunches under its paws and birds sing in the distance.

The red fox keeps trotting through the fresh snow as the pine trees thin out, then comes out of the forest onto the snowy shore of a wide frozen lake and slows to a walk. The camera keeps tracking alongside it at ground level in the bright winter sun. Snow crunches under its paws and a light wind blows across the ice.

A black raven perches on a snow-covered pine branch above a frozen lake, turning its head to watch something below. It ruffles its feathers, caws twice and takes off, shaking snow from the branch. Close-up shot with a shallow depth of field in bright winter sunlight. Its caws echo across the silent lake.

The red fox stands still on the snowy shore of the frozen lake, its ears pricked toward the cawing of a raven. It sniffs the air, then steps carefully onto the ice and trots away from the camera across the frozen lake, leaving small paw prints in a thin layer of snow. The camera stays low on the shore in the bright winter sun. The ice creaks softly and the wind whistles.
